verdict.rationale: Formant documents multiple public APIs/SDKs (Agent SDK, Cloud SDK, Admin API, RealtimeSDK/toolkit) for telemetry ingestion, commands, teleoperation and custom app building, with a GitHub toolkit repo for building custom applications. However, no formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec is discoverable (all candidate paths 404), limiting how 'documented' and machine-consumable the public API surface is for AI-native/agentic consumption. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, explicit agent-oriented API examples (e.g., function-calling schemas), and independent third-party confirmation of API robustness.
